summary: All community.mysql modules are deprecated for removal in 5.0.0; the content moved as-is to ansible.mysql, so change FQCNs.
questions: How do I migrate from community.mysql to ansible.mysql?

answer_card.title: Migrate from community.mysql to ansible.mysql
answer_card.answer_md: All community.mysql modules are deprecated and removed in version 5.0.0. The content moved **as-is** to `ansible.mysql`. Install it and change FQCNs, for example `community.mysql.mysql_info` → `ansible.mysql.mysql_info`.
